name: SettingRow
title: Templates/Platform/Forms/SettingRow
summary: The settings row, one field inside a flush `Card`: an `Item` whose content carries the title and description, where the title is the label and the control takes it as `aria-label`. Its kind follows what the control needs: a typed or picked field sits right in a cell capped at the 3xs container so every field on the card ends at the same edge; a switch or a button sits hard right at its natural width; a textarea, list, radio group or editor drops under the copy at the full measure. A message under a field or wide control, amber for required and red for invalid, appears only after Save. A child field indents one or two levels under a rule. Account settings, build settings, every create page and the generic resource settings page are built from it. Built from `Card`, `Item`, `Input`, `Select`, `Switch`, `Textarea`, `Button` and `HelperText`.

variants.name: CompactRows
variants.summary: The Login Settings card of Account Settings: two switches and a Manage button, each at its natural width against the right edge.

variants.name: WithMessage
variants.summary: A Name row after Save was pressed with it empty, as the resource settings and create pages render it: the input carries its required state and the amber message sits under it inside the control column.

variants.name: Nested
variants.summary: The protocol rows of a domain’s Advanced section: the HTTPS rows indent one level under HTTPS support and HTTP/3 ports a second level under HTTP/3 support, each behind a rule, and they leave when the switch above them turns off.
